note: Two street-level photos (facade and facade2), taken in different years, each cropped to one Amsterdam house front.

same_building.instructions: Do `facade` and `facade2` show the same house front (the same building, ignoring season, light, vehicles, trees and camera differences)?

criteria.false: Different buildings or clearly different fronts.

same_paint.instructions: Is the wall of the house front in `facade2` the same colour and finish (same brick or same paint colour) as in `facade`, ignoring lighting, shadow and camera colour differences?

criteria.false: The wall was repainted or has a different colour or material.

same_shopfront.instructions: Is the ground floor of the house front in `facade2` the same as in `facade` (same shopfront or same doors and windows, ignoring signs, awnings, vehicles and people)?

criteria.false: A different shopfront or ground floor.
